hero.headline: Receipt in. Invoice out. Taxes handled.

how.label: How it works

how.step2Desc: Claude Vision reads vendor name, invoice number, date, subtotal, VAT and total. No manual entry.
how.step3Desc: Confirm the extracted data in one click. Invoices are stored, filterable and ready to export.

features.label: Features
features.title: Built for freelancers and small businesses
features.feat1Desc: Understands handwriting, multi-language receipts and low-quality photos with high accuracy.
features.feat2Desc: Covers 16 countries — Spain, Switzerland, Germany and more. VAT validation and reverse-charge detection built in.
features.feat3Desc: EUR, CHF, USD and more. Amounts stored in integer cents — zero rounding errors, ever.
features.feat4Desc: Install it like a native app on any device. Scan receipts from your phone, review on desktop.

cta.title: Stop entering invoices by hand
cta.subtitle: Join Invoice Auto and let AI handle the paperwork while you focus on your business.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: An approved invoice is a correct invoice; that does not make it a safe payment. Here each invoice is decided: what gets paid, what needs a second look and what is held.

outcome.payHint: Nothing to flag. They go into the next payment file.
outcome.reviewHint: A person must look at them. They can accept with a note, valid only for this exact evaluation.
outcome.stopHint: Something must be fixed first. A hold is resolved, never skipped.

reasons.already_scheduled: Already in a generated payment file.
reasons.not_approved: The invoice is not approved yet (status: {status}). Approve it under Invoices first.
reasons.currency_unsupported: Currency {currency}: only EUR and CHF are paid.
reasons.no_bank_account: No bank account on file for this supplier.
reasons.no_bank_account_with_iban: No account on file. The invoice shows {invoice_iban}: register it and confirm it through an independent channel before paying.
reasons.account_unverified: Account {iban} is waiting for confirmation through an independent channel.
reasons.iban_mismatch: The invoice asks for payment to {invoice_iban}, but the verified account is {account_iban}. This is the classic bank-detail-change fraud: call the supplier on a known number before doing anything.
reasons.duplicate_exact: Duplicate: the same supplier already issued invoice {other_number} ({other_date}), status: {other_state}.
reasons.route_unsupported: No payment in {currency} to an account in {country}.
reasons.qr_iban_needs_qrr: {iban} is a QR-IBAN and only accepts payments with a QR reference (27 digits). It is missing or invalid.
reasons.qrr_needs_qr_iban: The invoice has a QR reference, but {iban} is not a QR-IBAN. The bank would reject it.
reasons.duplicate_probable: Possible duplicate of {other_number} ({other_date}): same amount, close dates.
reasons.amount_above_threshold: Amount at or above the four-eyes threshold ({threshold_cents}).
reasons.amount_anomaly: Amount is {factor}× this supplier's median ({median_cents}, {sample} invoices).
reasons.supplier_without_tax_id: The supplier is identified by name only, without a VAT/tax id.
reasons.overdue: Overdue by {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
reasons.no_due_date: No due date: payment proposed for the next business day.

suppliers.title: Supplier accounts
suppliers.intro: Every new or changed IBAN starts unverified. Verifying means confirming it through a channel that does not come from the invoice or the email: a call to the number you already had, in person, a signed letter or the bank's confirmation.
suppliers.empty: No accounts yet. They are registered from an invoice held for lack of an account.
suppliers.contactHint: The one you had before this invoice, never the one printed on it.

batches.title: Payment files
batches.intro: ISO 20022 pain.001.001.09 files, valid for SEPA and the Swiss SPS standard. Generating one moves no money: you download it and upload it to your e-banking.
batches.markExecutedConfirm: Has the bank already executed this file? Its invoices will become paid.
batches.cancelHint: The invoices return to the queue and are decided again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every decision and state change, with its evidence. Append-only: the database refuses to modify or delete entries.

settings.title: Payment settings
settings.thresholdHint: Amounts at or above this go to review, in the invoice's currency.
settings.coolingOffHint: After a changed IBAN is verified, payments wait this long. It gives the real supplier time to notice a fraud.
